aca_welcome_desc: Susedko is a platform that lets you offer your services to customers nearby. Create a profile, set your availability calendar and start accepting orders — all through the app.
aca_verification_desc: After registration, your profile goes through an approval process. Customers will see you only after successful verification. The process has three steps:
aca_verification_email: We'll send a contract to your registration email for you to sign. Sign it as soon as possible so you can start accepting jobs.
aca_verification_contract: After signing the contract, our team will review your profile and professions.
aca_verification_admin: Once approved by an administrator, your profile will be shown to customers and you can start earning.
aca_howto_profile_desc: Add a photo, bio, hourly rate and professions. A quality profile attracts more customers.
aca_howto_calendar_desc: Mark the days and hours you're available. Customers can only book you during times you've marked as free.
aca_howto_requests_desc: Customers can send you a direct request. You accept or decline and arrange details by phone.
aca_howto_broadcast_desc: Customers can post a request visible to all craftsmen in your category. Show interest and the customer may choose you.
aca_howto_payment_desc: You enter the hours worked, the customer approves them, and payment goes through the app. No cash, no waiting.
aca_calendar_desc: The calendar is at the heart of your work on Susedko. Customers can only book you during times marked as available. The more accurate your calendar, the more jobs you'll get.
aca_calendar_tip1: Update your calendar regularly — ideally every week.
aca_calendar_tip2: If you're unavailable, uncheck those slots — this avoids conflicts.
aca_calendar_tip3: Confirmed bookings cannot be removed from the calendar.
aca_payment_step1: After completing the job, you enter the hours actually worked.
aca_payment_step2: The customer gets a notification and can approve the hours or request an adjustment.
aca_payment_step3: Once approved, the customer pays directly through the app.
aca_payment_step4: Payment will be transferred to the bank account listed in your profile.
aca_payment_note: Payment is secured via Stripe. You receive exactly what the customer agreed to.
aca_ratings_desc: After every completed job, the customer can rate your work. Ratings are visible to all customers and directly affect how many jobs you get.
aca_ratings_tip1: More positive ratings = more customers and higher income.
aca_ratings_tip2: Be punctual, communicative, and deliver quality work — good ratings will follow.

aboutApp_intro: Susedko is an app that connects people with craftsmen in their area. Need a repair, help around the house, or an expert? Just a few clicks and the solution is within reach.
aboutApp_howto_intro: Just set your location in your profile and instantly see available craftsmen near you.
aboutApp_feature_order_text: Choose a specific craftsman and book an appointment based on their calendar.
aboutApp_feature_service_text: Send a request directly to your chosen craftsman and arrange an appointment.
aboutApp_feature_broadcast_text: Your request is shown to all craftsmen in the category — more offers, better choice.
aboutApp_feature_notif_text: Push notifications about orders, hours, and payments — always in control.
aboutApp_payment_step1: After finishing the job, the craftsman logs the hours worked.
aboutApp_payment_step2: The hours are sent to you for approval — you can confirm them or request an adjustment.
aboutApp_payment_step3: Once approved, a payment is generated, which you pay directly in the app.
aboutApp_payment_note: Payment is secured via Stripe. You only pay for approved hours.
aboutApp_earn_title: For anyone who wants to earn
aboutApp_earn_intro: Susedko isn't just for customers — it's also for anyone who wants to earn extra income.
aboutApp_earn_highlight1: Open to men and women alike — regardless of experience or profession.
aboutApp_earn_highlight2: Build your own income and reputation through customer ratings.
aboutApp_professions_intro: Susedko is for everyone — men and women who want to help others and earn at the same time.
aboutApp_prof_technical_text: Plumber, electrician, heating technician, gas fitter, tinsmith, welder, appliance repair, locksmith, bricklayer, painter, tiler, floor layer, carpenter.
aboutApp_prof_home_text: Cleaning, gardener, moving, furniture assembly, household help, IT technician.
aboutApp_prof_care_text: Senior caregiver, childcare, pet care, medical assistant, physiotherapist, psychologist.
aboutApp_prof_beauty_text: Beautician, hairdresser, massage therapist, trainer, swimming instructor, dance instructor, photographer, event organizer.
aboutApp_professions_footer: It doesn't matter whether you're a professional or just want to earn extra — Susedko is where customers easily find you.
